 DEPARTMENT {
 int department_id PK
 string name
 }

 PROGRAM {

 string name
 int department_id FK
 }

 }

 }

 }

 RESEARCH_PROJECT {

 }

 }

 }

 }

 }

 PUBLICATION {

 string title

 }

 STUDENT_PUBLICATION_AUTHOR {

 }

 FACULTY_PUBLICATION_AUTHOR {

 }

 }

 }

 }

 }

 }

 }

 string purpose
 }",
